items.title: Uber (UBER) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Analysts Rework Targets
items.summary: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Uber Technologies from about US$101.24 per share to roughly US$99.16 per share, signaling a small reset in modeled upside. Many research firms are refreshing their price targets after the latest results, reflecting different views on how durable Uber’s growth and profit path may be and how current risks could influence where the stock eventually trades.
